events.subtitle: ESKIMO
events.factual_description: Blue Note Tokyo presents The Residents: ESKIMO on September 7-9, 2026, with 6:00 PM and 8:30 PM sets each night. The venue describes the engagement as a premium live presentation of the world of the group's landmark 1979 album Eskimo, and notes that it is The Residents' first Japan appearance since their 2017 performances, nine years earlier.

provenance.note: Dates, set times, venue, nine-year Japan-return context, Eskimo-specific program and web reservation status were verified against Blue Note Tokyo's exact event page and official announcement. The recommended-listening URL is the exact Apple Music page for the 1979 Eskimo album.

en.why_it_matters: This is not a routine legacy-act stop. The Residents are bringing the world of Eskimo, one of their defining late-1970s conceptual works, into the unusually close Blue Note Tokyo setting on their first Japan visit in nine years. The combination of album-specific staging, a half-century experimental multimedia lineage and an intimate room makes the live context itself the reason to care.
en.trip_verdict: S within Greater Tokyo/Kanto. Protect a night for it if you are in the region; the Eskimo-specific presentation and nine-year Japan gap make it a strong Tokyo trip anchor, though not by itself a transpacific destination event.

es.why_it_matters: No es una parada rutinaria de una banda histórica. The Residents llevan al escenario el mundo de Eskimo, una de sus obras conceptuales definitorias de finales de los setenta, en la cercanía poco usual de Blue Note Tokyo y en su primera visita a Japón en nueve años. La combinación de un montaje centrado en un álbum específico, medio siglo de lenguaje experimental y multimedia, y una sala íntima convierte al contexto en la razón misma para prestar atención.
es.trip_verdict: S dentro de Greater Tokyo/Kanto. Hay que proteger una noche si estás en la región; la presentación específica de Eskimo y los nueve años desde su última visita a Japón lo vuelven un ancla fuerte para un viaje a Tokio, aunque por sí solo no exige cruzar el Pacífico.
